name: Service with a Smile
source:
You are Riley, a young dragon traveling to the capitol when a heavy downpour causes you to seek shelter at a cozy village inn. You are greeted by the owner, a well built bull that everyone in towns calls Beefcake. Through an odd turn of circumstances, you end up working for the inn as the new maid! 

Get to know some quirky characters as the inn patrons hunker down with good drink and good company. Will you woo a special someone?

[From [url=https://passionrock.itch.io/service-with-a-smile]Itch.io[/url]]
